calls.why: first ADD attempt, rejected because the product had no image
added one image to the demo product so merchandising would accept it

notes: The demo product 652907899 was deleted with 204 No Content. A get_a_product on it afterwards returned 404 product-not-found (detail: Product 652907899 was not found.), so it no longer exists in the inventory.

The first update_a_product_s_merchandising ADD call returned 422 merchandising-rejected: This product isn't ready to publish: 1 thing(s) to fix. The error named the media field: Add at least one image. Images are processed in the background, so retry shortly if one was just added.

To get past that, the recorder made one extra update_a_product call on the demo product only, adding one image (the Boring Show thumbnail URL already on images.whatnot.com, alt text API demo placeholder). That response still showed media as an empty list, but the ADD retry about 9 seconds later succeeded with 200. The update_a_product fixture keeps the planned description change, not this extra call.
create_a_product accepted a dimension profile given by id only (123059), so the inline weight fallback was not needed.

update_product_variants, set_inventory and adjust_inventory all answered 207 Multi-Status even though every item succeeded and allow_partial_updates was false. The variant update did not need auction pricing.

A new product starts with merchandising already set to buy_it_now and reserved_for_live true. The request field is reserve_for_live but the response field is reserved_for_live. The update response does not list shows; list_a_product_s_shows is the way to confirm.
The REMOVE call returned 200 with the same body as ADD, so removed_from_show is based on that 200; there was no follow-up list_a_product_s_shows before the delete.
get_show_analytics on the private test show returned calculation_status WILL_NOT_BE_CALCULATED with every metric null.

The livestreams report was already completed about 17 seconds after it was requested. Its report_url is a signed S3 CSV link valid for 7 days (X-Amz-Expires 604800). It was not fetched. It is kept in the get_a_report fixture because reports are not redacted under the contract.

Through the connector, error responses (4xx) come back with body as a JSON string and content type application/problem+json; the fixtures store that string parsed into an object. The 204 delete came back with body as an empty string, stored as is.
list_shipments and get_a_shipment already return destination_address as null for this account, so only recipient names needed redacting.
The rate limit header was ratelimit-limit 2, 2;w=1 on every call and ratelimit-remaining never went below 1. No 429 was seen.
disconnect_the_current_application was not called; its fixture is mode not_run.

order lists each function once in the order it was first run, with disconnect_the_current_application last as not run. calls lists every connector call in sequence, including the retry, the extra image update and the check after delete.
